prep.text: Cut [300 g] pork into 3–4 mm slices. Mix with [2 tsp] fish sauce, [1 tsp] sugar, [3 g] minced garlic and [0.125 tsp] pepper. Label MON LUNCH — PORK.
Peel and devein [100 g] shrimp (or buy cleaned). Keep unseasoned in a separate sealed container labelled MON LUNCH — SOUP SHRIMP.
Peel winter melon, remove mature seeds, wash and slice 5 mm thick. Weigh [350 g]. Label MON LUNCH — MELON; refrigerate.
Measure [1 tsp] fish sauce into a separate soup-seasoning cup. Label and refrigerate.

steps.text: Add [600 ml] water to a pot, cover and bring to a boil over high heat.
Heat [1 tsp] oil in a pan over medium heat for 30 seconds. Add the entire pre-seasoned pork portion; spread and stir.
Add [45 ml] water. Reduce to medium-low and simmer, stirring occasionally. Add a spoonful of water if dry before the meat cooks.
Meanwhile add the prepared melon to the boiling pot.
Add the soup shrimp and cook until the melon is tender and shrimp are completely opaque.
Add the separate soup-seasoning cup, stir and turn off the pot.
Verify pork is safely cooked; let it rest 3 minutes before eating. Serve with rice.

meals.storage: Keep raw protein sealed in the refrigerator at 4°C or below and use on Monday. Refrigerate the prepared vegetables and sauce.
meals.thaw: No thawing needed if prepared fresh on Sunday.

prep.text: Cut [300 g] basa into portions about 2 cm thick; pat dry. Label MON DINNER — FISH and refrigerate unseasoned.
Mix [2 tsp] fish sauce, [1 tsp] sugar and [0.125 tsp] pepper into a sauce cup. Keep [5 g] minced shallot separate. Label both MON DINNER.
Trim tough water-spinach stems, remove damaged leaves, wash and drain thoroughly. Weigh [300 g]. Refrigerate in a clean container lined with paper towel.

steps.text: Bring [1000 ml] water to a boil in a covered pot.
Heat [1 tsp] oil in a pan over medium heat; add the separate shallot and stir for 20 seconds.
Add fish, the sauce cup and [80 ml] water. Bring to a gentle simmer.
Cover and cook over medium-low heat, spooning sauce over the fish without vigorous stirring.
Meanwhile add the water spinach to boiling water; press gently under the water. Cook until tender and lift out.
Check the thickest part of the fish reaches 63°C. If sauce is too thin, uncover briefly; if drying before fish cooks, add water. Serve with rice.

meals.storage: Keep raw protein sealed in the refrigerator at 4°C or below and use on Monday. Refrigerate the prepared vegetables and sauce.
meals.thaw: No thawing needed if prepared fresh on Sunday.

prep.text: Cut [300 g] chicken into 2 cm pieces. Do not wash raw chicken. Mix with [2 tsp] fish sauce, [0.5 tsp] sugar, [15 g] minced lemongrass and optional [1 g] chili. Label TUE LUNCH — CHICKEN and freeze promptly.
Wash [300 g] mustard greens and cut into 3–4 cm pieces. Blanch in boiling water for 1 minute, cool quickly in clean ice water and drain well; freeze in a meal bag. This is not the final cooking step.
Slice [5 g] ginger thinly. Pack separately and freeze. Measure [0.25 tsp] salt into a labelled soup cup.

steps.text: Add [600 ml] water and the prepared ginger to a pot; cover and bring to a boil.
Heat [2 tsp] oil over medium heat. Add the entire thawed, seasoned chicken portion and stir.
Add [30 ml] water, cover and cook over medium-low heat.
Uncover and stir until chicken reaches 74°C in its thickest piece.
Meanwhile add the frozen greens to the boiling pot; return to a boil and cook.
Stir in the separate salt portion, turn off the pot and serve. Do not season the chicken again.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Monday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Slice [300 g] beef 3–4 mm thick. Mix with [1 tsp] oil and [0.125 tsp] pepper only. Label TUE DINNER — BEEF and freeze promptly.

Peel and wash onion; slice [200 g] into thin wedges. Refrigerate separately. Wash and dry [300 g] cucumber; refrigerate WHOLE for better texture. Slicing is the one remaining fresh-prep task at dinner.
Mix [15 ml] lime juice, [1 tsp] sugar and [1 tsp] fish sauce for the cucumber dressing; label and refrigerate.
Keep [5 g] minced garlic and [1 tsp] fish sauce for the stir-fry separate; label and freeze.

steps.text: Slice the washed cucumber about 3 mm thick. Toss with the prepared dressing and set aside.
Heat [1 tsp] oil over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the prepared onion, then transfer it to a clean plate.
Add [1 tsp] oil to the pan and the separate garlic; stir for 10 seconds.
Add the thawed beef and spread it out. Stir-fry until safely cooked; time varies with pan and thickness.
Return the onion, add the separate stir-fry fish sauce and stir for 30–60 seconds.
Check beef is cooked; rest 3 minutes before eating. Toss cucumber again and serve.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Monday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Divide cleaned shrimp into [300 g] for the main and [100 g] for soup. Keep both unseasoned, separately labelled WED LUNCH — MAIN SHRIMP / SOUP SHRIMP; freeze promptly.
Mix [2 tsp] fish sauce, [1 tsp] sugar and [5 g] minced shallot into a main-sauce cup. Freeze separately. Measure another [1 tsp] fish sauce into a soup cup.
Trim and wash [300 g] Malabar spinach. Cut into manageable pieces, blanch 1 minute, cool quickly in clean ice water and drain thoroughly; freeze in a labelled meal bag.

steps.text: Bring [600 ml] water to a boil in a pot.
Heat [1 tsp] oil over medium heat; add the main shrimp and stir.
Add the main sauce cup and [30 ml] water. Simmer over medium-low heat, stirring until shrimp are opaque and sauce lightly thickens.
Meanwhile add frozen Malabar spinach to the boiling pot and return to a boil.
Add the soup shrimp; cook until all shrimp are opaque.
Stir in the soup-seasoning cup. Turn off both burners and serve; avoid overcooking shrimp until dry.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Tuesday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Mix [150 g] ground pork with [0.5 tsp] fish sauce and [0.125 tsp] pepper. Label WED DINNER — PORK and freeze promptly.
Keep [3 each] eggs intact in their carton in the refrigerator; do not crack or mix with raw pork in advance.
Wash and drain [300 g] cabbage, cut into 3 cm pieces and refrigerate separately. Check freshness before use; discard if spoiled.
Wash and finely slice [10 g] spring onion, drain and freeze separately.

steps.text: Bring [1000 ml] water to a boil in a covered pot.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, add prepared spring onion and beat. Do not add more fish sauce.
Heat [2 tsp] oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Add thawed ground pork; break into small crumbs and cook fully to at least 71°C.
Spread cooked pork evenly. Pour in the egg, reduce to medium-low, cover and cook.
Divide into 4 pieces with a spatula, flip each and cook until egg is fully set and centre reaches 71°C.
Meanwhile boil the prepared cabbage until tender, then lift out and drain.
Serve. Cooking pork before adding egg avoids a thick raw-meat centre.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Tuesday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Portion [300 g] tilapia into pieces about 2 cm thick. Pat dry, leave unseasoned, label THU LUNCH — FISH and freeze promptly.
Mix [2 tsp] fish sauce and [0.5 tsp] sugar into a separate sauce cup; label and freeze. Measure [0.25 tsp] salt separately for soup.
Peel pumpkin, remove seeds, wash and weigh [350 g]. Cut 5 mm thick; freeze in a labelled soup bag.

steps.text: Put [600 ml] water and frozen pumpkin into a pot; cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce to medium and cook until a chopstick passes easily through pumpkin.
Pat the thawed fish dry with clean kitchen paper.
Heat [1 tbsp] oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat for 1 minute. Add fish and leave undisturbed.
Turn carefully and cook the second side. Check the thickest part reaches 63°C; cook longer if needed.
Pour in the sauce cup and [15 ml] water at the pan edge; spoon over fish and simmer 30–60 seconds.
Add the measured salt to soup and turn off both burners. Serve.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Wednesday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Slice [300 g] pork 3–4 mm thick. Mix with [2 tsp] fish sauce, [0.5 tsp] sugar, [30 g] minced lemongrass and optional [1 g] chili. Label THU DINNER — PORK and freeze promptly.
Peel chayote and remove mature seed. Wash, weigh [400 g] and cut into 5 mm slices. Blanch 2 minutes, cool quickly in clean ice water and drain well; freeze in a meal bag.

steps.text: Bring [1000 ml] water to a boil in a covered pot.
Heat [2 tsp] oil over medium heat. Add the entire thawed pork portion and stir.
Add [30 ml] water. Cook, stirring, until pork is safely cooked and most liquid evaporates. Reduce heat if lemongrass browns too fast.
Meanwhile put frozen chayote into the boiling pot; return to a boil.
Cook until the thickest slice is tender, then drain.
Do not add fish sauce again: pork is already seasoned. Verify pork is cooked and rest 3 minutes before eating.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Wednesday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Cut [300 g] chicken into 2 cm pieces. Mix with [1 tbsp] fish sauce, [1 tsp] sugar and [15 g] finely sliced ginger. Label FRI LUNCH — CHICKEN and freeze promptly.
Keep [100 g] ground pork unseasoned in a separate bag labelled FRI LUNCH — SOUP PORK; freeze promptly.
Wash [250 g] cabbage and cut into 1 cm strips. Blanch 1 minute, cool quickly and drain thoroughly; freeze.
Measure [1 tsp] fish sauce into a separate soup cup, label and freeze.

steps.text: Bring [600 ml] water to a boil in a pot.
Heat [1 tsp] oil over medium heat. Add the entire seasoned chicken portion and stir.
Add [45 ml] water, cover and simmer over medium-low heat.
Meanwhile add the soup pork gradually to the boiling pot. Stir into small crumbs; return to a boil and cook.
Add frozen cabbage, return to a boil and cook until tender. Check ground pork has cooked fully.
Add the soup-seasoning cup and turn off the pot.
Check chicken reaches 74°C. Uncover the pan for 1–2 minutes if sauce needs thickening, then serve.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Thursday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Slice [300 g] beef 3–4 mm thick. Mix with [1 tsp] oil and [0.125 tsp] pepper; leave fish sauce out. Label FRI DINNER — BEEF and freeze promptly.
Trim ends and strings from green beans, wash, weigh [300 g] and cut into 3–4 cm pieces. Blanch 2 minutes, cool quickly in clean ice water and drain; freeze.
Wash [300 g] tomato, remove stems and cut into wedges; freeze in a soup bag.

Keep [5 g] minced garlic, [1 tsp] fish sauce for beef, another [1 tsp] fish sauce for soup, and [10 g] sliced spring onion in separately labelled portions; freeze. Keep [2 each] eggs intact in their carton in the refrigerator.

steps.text: Put [600 ml] water and frozen tomato in a pot; cover and bring to a boil.
Reduce to medium and simmer tomatoes.
In a pan, add [1 tsp] oil, frozen beans and [30 ml] water. Cover and cook over medium heat, stirring midway.
Check beans are cooked through, with no hard raw centre; extend cooking if needed. Transfer to a clean plate.
Beat the eggs in a bowl. Drizzle into the gently boiling soup while stirring slowly.
Cook until egg is fully set; add prepared spring onion and the soup fish sauce, then turn off.
Heat [1 tsp] oil over medium-high heat. Add the separate garlic for 10 seconds, then add thawed beef and stir-fry until safely cooked.
Return beans, add the separate beef fish sauce and stir for 30–60 seconds. Check beef is cooked; rest 3 minutes before eating and serve.

meals.storage: Freeze the raw protein and meal sauces promptly after Sunday prep. Keep frozen vegetables frozen until cooking. Follow the individual vegetable instructions.
meals.thaw: On Thursday morning, move this meal’s protein and sauce to the refrigerator on a leakproof tray. Check they are fully thawed before cooking. Never thaw on the counter.

prep.text: Slice the tomatoes, mince the garlic and trim the bok choy. Pat the fish dry; wash hands and clean surfaces after handling raw fish.

steps.text: Rinse [150 g] rice and cook in a covered saucepan with water according to the packet, about 15–20 minutes.
Heat [1 tbsp] oil over medium heat. Sear [300 g] mackerel for 2 minutes per side, then transfer to a plate.
Soften [10 g] garlic and [200 g] tomato in the pan. Add a splash of water and [0.5 tsp] salt; simmer for 5 minutes. Return the fish and gently simmer until the centre reaches 63°C.
Boil [200 g] bok choy in a separate saucepan for 2–3 minutes until tender. Serve with the fish, tomato sauce and rice.

alternatives.storage: Refrigerate promptly at 4°C or below. Use cooked leftovers within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot. Freeze raw proteins if not cooking within 1–2 days.
alternatives.thaw: Thaw frozen proteins in a covered container in the refrigerator; never on the counter.

prep.text: Cut chicken into small pieces on a separate board. Slice the cabbage and mince the garlic. Keep raw chicken separate from vegetables.

steps.text: Cook [150 g] rice in a covered saucepan following the packet instructions. Keep covered and hot until serving.
Season [300 g] chicken with [1 tsp] turmeric and [0.5 tsp] salt. Heat [1 tbsp] oil and sauté [10 g] garlic for 30 seconds.
Add the chicken and cook over medium heat for 8–10 minutes, turning regularly, until the thickest piece reaches 74°C. Transfer to a clean plate.
Add [250 g] cabbage and a splash of water to the pan. Stir-fry for 4–5 minutes until tender. Serve the chicken and cabbage with hot rice.

alternatives.storage: Refrigerate promptly at 4°C or below. Use cooked leftovers within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot. Freeze raw proteins if not cooking within 1–2 days.
alternatives.thaw: Thaw frozen proteins in a covered container in the refrigerator; never on the counter.

prep.text: Slice squid into even rings on a separate board. Slice pineapple and cucumber; mince garlic. Refrigerate squid until cooking.

steps.text: Cook [150 g] rice in a covered saucepan with water as directed on the packet. Keep hot while preparing the stir-fry.
Heat [1 tbsp] oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Add [10 g] garlic and stir for 30 seconds without burning.
Add [300 g] squid, spread in a single layer and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes. Add [200 g] pineapple, [150 g] cucumber and [0.5 tsp] salt.
Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until vegetables soften slightly and squid is opaque, firm and reaches 63°C. Serve immediately with rice.

alternatives.storage: Refrigerate promptly at 4°C or below. Use cooked leftovers within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot. Freeze raw proteins if not cooking within 1–2 days.
alternatives.thaw: Thaw frozen proteins in a covered container in the refrigerator; never on the counter.

prep.text: Dice tomatoes, mince garlic and slice cucumber. Keep raw beef and its utensils separate from the salad.

steps.text: Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Cook [160 g] spaghetti according to the packet, then drain, reserving a little pasta water.
Heat [1 tbsp] oil, add [10 g] garlic and stir for 30 seconds. Add [250 g] minced beef and break it up; cook thoroughly until it reaches 71°C.
Add [300 g] tomato and [0.5 tsp] salt. Simmer for 8–10 minutes until saucy, adding reserved pasta water if needed. Toss in the spaghetti.
Toss [150 g] cucumber with [1 tbsp] lemon juice using clean utensils. Serve beside the hot spaghetti.

alternatives.storage: Refrigerate promptly at 4°C or below. Use cooked leftovers within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot. Freeze raw proteins if not cooking within 1–2 days.
alternatives.thaw: Thaw frozen proteins in a covered container in the refrigerator; never on the counter.

prep.text: Dice carrots finely, mince garlic and slice cucumber. Crack eggs into a clean bowl and beat. Use freshly cooked rice rather than rice left at room temperature.

steps.text: Cook [150 g] rice in a covered saucepan as directed on the packet. Fluff with a clean fork; fry it while still hot.
Heat [1 tbsp] oil and sauté [10 g] garlic for 30 seconds. Add [100 g] carrot, [100 g] frozen peas and a splash of water. Cover for 4–5 minutes until tender.
Push vegetables aside and pour in [3 each] beaten eggs. Stir until the eggs are fully set with no runny parts.
Add the hot rice and [0.5 tsp] salt. Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until evenly mixed and steaming throughout. Serve with [150 g] fresh cucumber.

alternatives.storage: Refrigerate promptly at 4°C or below. Use cooked leftovers within 3 days and reheat until steaming hot. Freeze raw proteins if not cooking within 1–2 days.
alternatives.thaw: Thaw frozen proteins in a covered container in the refrigerator; never on the counter.

vi.Refrigerate promptly at 4°C or below. Us: Bảo quản lạnh ngay ở 4°C trở xuống. Dùng thức ăn chín còn dư trong 3 ngày và hâm nóng kỹ. Cấp đông thực phẩm đạm sống nếu chưa nấu trong 1–2 ngày.
vi.Thaw frozen proteins in a covered contai: Rã đông thực phẩm đạm trong hộp đậy kín ở ngăn mát; không rã đông ở nhiệt độ phòng.
vi.Slice the tomatoes, mince the garlic and: Cắt cà chua, băm tỏi và cắt gốc cải thìa. Thấm khô cá; rửa tay và vệ sinh dụng cụ sau khi xử lý cá sống.
vi.Rinse [150 g] rice and cook in a covered: Vo [150 g] gạo và nấu trong nồi đậy nắp với nước theo hướng dẫn trên bao bì, khoảng 15–20 phút.
vi.Heat [1 tbsp] oil over medium heat. Sear: Đun [1 tbsp] dầu ở lửa vừa. Áp chảo [300 g] cá thu trong 2 phút mỗi mặt rồi gắp ra đĩa.
vi.Soften [10 g] garlic and [200 g] tomato: Phi thơm [10 g] tỏi và xào mềm [200 g] cà chua. Thêm chút nước và [0.5 tsp] muối; nấu 5 phút. Cho cá vào, om nhỏ lửa đến khi tâm cá đạt 63°C.
vi.Boil [200 g] bok choy in a separate sauc: Luộc [200 g] cải thìa trong nồi riêng khoảng 2–3 phút đến khi mềm. Dùng cùng cá, sốt cà chua và cơm.
vi.Cut chicken into small pieces on a separ: Cắt gà thành miếng nhỏ trên thớt riêng. Thái bắp cải và băm tỏi. Giữ gà sống riêng với rau củ.
vi.Cook [150 g] rice in a covered saucepan: Nấu [150 g] gạo trong nồi đậy nắp theo hướng dẫn trên bao bì. Giữ cơm nóng đến khi dùng.
vi.Season [300 g] chicken with [1 tsp] turm: Ướp [300 g] gà với [1 tsp] bột nghệ và [0.5 tsp] muối. Đun [1 tbsp] dầu và phi [10 g] tỏi trong 30 giây.
vi.Add the chicken and cook over medium hea: Cho gà vào và nấu ở lửa vừa 8–10 phút, trở đều đến khi miếng dày nhất đạt 74°C. Gắp ra đĩa sạch.
vi.Add [250 g] cabbage and a splash of wate: Cho [250 g] bắp cải và chút nước vào chảo. Xào 4–5 phút đến khi mềm. Dùng gà và bắp cải với cơm nóng.
vi.Slice squid into even rings on a separat: Cắt mực thành khoanh đều trên thớt riêng. Thái dứa, dưa leo và băm tỏi. Giữ mực lạnh đến khi nấu.
vi.Cook [150 g] rice in a covered saucepan: Nấu [150 g] gạo trong nồi đậy nắp với nước theo hướng dẫn trên bao bì. Giữ cơm nóng khi xào mực.
vi.Heat [1 tbsp] oil in a wide pan over med: Đun [1 tbsp] dầu trong chảo rộng ở lửa vừa lớn. Cho [10 g] tỏi vào đảo 30 giây, tránh cháy.
vi.Add [300 g] squid, spread in a single la: Cho [300 g] mực vào, dàn đều và xào 2–3 phút. Thêm [200 g] dứa, [150 g] dưa leo và [0.5 tsp] muối.
vi.Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until vegetable: Xào thêm 2–3 phút đến khi rau củ hơi mềm và mực chuyển đục, săn lại, đạt 63°C. Dùng ngay với cơm.
vi.Tomato beef spaghetti: Mì Ý sốt bò cà chua
vi.Dice tomatoes, mince garlic and slice cu: Cắt hạt lựu cà chua, băm tỏi và thái dưa leo. Để bò sống và dụng cụ xử lý riêng với món trộn.
vi.Bring a saucepan of water to a boil. Coo: Đun sôi nước trong nồi. Luộc [160 g] mì Ý theo hướng dẫn trên bao bì rồi để ráo, giữ lại chút nước luộc mì.
vi.Heat [1 tbsp] oil, add [10 g] garlic and: Đun [1 tbsp] dầu, cho [10 g] tỏi vào đảo 30 giây. Thêm [250 g] bò xay, dằm tơi và nấu chín kỹ đến 71°C.
vi.Add [300 g] tomato and [0.5 tsp] salt. S: Cho [300 g] cà chua và [0.5 tsp] muối vào. Nấu nhỏ lửa 8–10 phút đến khi thành sốt, thêm nước luộc mì nếu cần. Trộn mì Ý vào sốt.
vi.Toss [150 g] cucumber with [1 tbsp] lemo: Dùng dụng cụ sạch trộn [150 g] dưa leo với [1 tbsp] nước cốt chanh. Dùng kèm mì Ý nóng.
vi.Dice carrots finely, mince garlic and sl: Cắt nhỏ cà rốt, băm tỏi và thái dưa leo. Đập trứng vào bát sạch rồi đánh đều. Dùng cơm mới nấu, không dùng cơm để lâu ở nhiệt độ phòng.
vi.Cook [150 g] rice in a covered saucepan: Nấu [150 g] gạo trong nồi đậy nắp theo hướng dẫn trên bao bì. Xới tơi bằng nĩa sạch và chiên khi cơm còn nóng.
vi.Heat [1 tbsp] oil and sauté [10 g] garli: Đun [1 tbsp] dầu và phi [10 g] tỏi trong 30 giây. Thêm [100 g] cà rốt, [100 g] đậu Hà Lan đông lạnh và chút nước. Đậy nắp 4–5 phút đến khi mềm.
vi.Push vegetables aside and pour in [3 eac: Gạt rau củ sang một bên và đổ [3 each] trứng đã đánh vào. Đảo đến khi trứng chín hoàn toàn, không còn phần lỏng.
vi.Add the hot rice and [0.5 tsp] salt. Sti: Cho cơm nóng và [0.5 tsp] muối vào. Đảo 3–4 phút đến khi đều và nóng kỹ. Dùng với [150 g] dưa leo tươi.
